name: vectorise-mcp

tools.name: vectorize_image
tools.description: Convert a raster image file (JPG, PNG, BMP, WEBP, AVIF — up to 25 MB) into a scalable SVG vector. Writes the SVG next to the input file (or to output_path) and returns the saved path plus conversion stats. For most images just set `preset` (logo, photo, illustration, pixel_art, technical_drawing) or leave everything unset for full auto-detection. Use quality_tier to trade speed vs fidelity.

image_path.description: Absolute path to the input image file

output_path.description: Where to save the SVG. Defaults to the input path with a .svg extension

preset.description: Friendly preset matching the app UI: auto (engine detects image type), logo (sharp edges, exact brand colours), illustration (drawings/cartoons/clipart), photo (smooth tonal gradients), pixel_art (pixel-faithful, exact colours), technical_drawing (line art, black & white). Explicit options you pass override preset values.

quality_tier.description: Speed/quality trade-off. Default balanced_crisp (credits: fast=1, balanced_crisp=2, high_precision=5)

quality_profile.description: Advanced: engine profile. Prefer `preset` unless you know the engine. Default auto

palette_count.description: Target number of colours (sets manual palette mode)

preserve_exact_colors.description: Keep source colours without merging similar shades

tools.name: vectorize_batch
tools.description: Convert up to 20 raster image files to SVG in one call. The same settings (preset, quality_tier, etc.) apply to every image. Files are converted sequentially and each gets an independent result — one bad file does not fail the batch. SVGs are saved next to each input (or into output_dir). Credits are charged per successful conversion.

image_paths.description: Absolute paths of the input image files (1–20)

output_dir.description: Directory to save all SVGs into. Defaults to saving next to each input file

preset.description: Friendly preset matching the app UI: auto (engine detects image type), logo (sharp edges, exact brand colours), illustration (drawings/cartoons/clipart), photo (smooth tonal gradients), pixel_art (pixel-faithful, exact colours), technical_drawing (line art, black & white). Explicit options you pass override preset values.

quality_tier.description: Speed/quality trade-off. Default balanced_crisp (credits: fast=1, balanced_crisp=2, high_precision=5)

quality_profile.description: Advanced: engine profile. Prefer `preset` unless you know the engine. Default auto

palette_count.description: Target number of colours (sets manual palette mode)

preserve_exact_colors.description: Keep source colours without merging similar shades

tools.name: export_svg
tools.description: Convert an SVG file to PDF, EPS, DXF, PNG, JPG, or WEBP via Vectorise.Me. EPS and DXF require a Pro plan. Writes the result next to the input (or to output_path).

svg_path.description: Absolute path to the input SVG file

output_path.description: Where to save the output. Defaults to the input path with the new extension

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show the plan, API credit balance, and recent daily usage for the configured Vectorise.Me API key.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: List available export formats and per-format options supported by the Vectorise.Me API. No auth required.
